page.notes: The top of the page is cut off, so the running head is partly lost. Many Greek headwords and the diacritics in them are doubtful. Some symbols after Greek words (for example after δήμο and Οἴ) could not be identified and are marked [?]. The large initial Π at the start of the Greek group is read as the first letter of Παϑ[?]. Latin words are read as printed. Greek entries are read with doubt: the marked Greek words and the accents may not be exact. Several Latin and Greek words are marked [?].
